name: yoink
description: A local-first, signal-driven commerce control plane with Chrome-only execution.

scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:types
scripts.build:extension: esbuild apps/extension/src/target-shadow.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=YoinkTargetShadowModule --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --legal-comments=none --outfile=apps/extension/target-shadow.js && esbuild apps/extension/src/target-action.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=YoinkTargetActionModule --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --legal-comments=none --outfile=apps/extension/target-action.js && esbuild apps/extension/src/retailer-shadow.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=YoinkRetailerShadowModule --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --legal-comments=none --outfile=apps/extension/retailer-shadow.js && esbuild apps/extension/src/observer-recipe-oracle.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=YoinkObserverRecipeOracleModule --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --legal-comments=none --outfile=apps/extension/observer-recipe-oracle.js && esbuild apps/extension/src/walmart-action.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=YoinkWalmartActionModule --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --legal-comments=none --outfile=apps/extension/walmart-action.js && esbuild apps/extension/src/amazon-action.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=YoinkAmazonActionModule --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --legal-comments=none --outfile=apps/extension/amazon-action.js && esbuild apps/extension/src/bestbuy-action.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=YoinkBestBuyActionModule --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --legal-comments=none --outfile=apps/extension/bestbuy-action.js && esbuild apps/extension/src/trackalacker-sync.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=YoinkTrackalackerSyncModule --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --legal-comments=none --outfile=apps/extension/trackalacker-sync.js
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm test
